title: Sikat eggplant (Sikat F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Sikat eggplant is an eggplant variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Sikat is a registered eggplant variety, also sold or known as Sikat F1 or Sikat talong. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2015 as NSIC 2015 Eg 05H.

heroImage.alt: Rows of young eggplant on furrowed beds in Norzagaray, Bulacan, the kind of farm where Sikat eggplant is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Sikat F1 or Sikat talong, this is the same eggplant. Its seller and farm sources add notes, listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [eggplant variety finder](/crop-varieties/eggplant), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper).

The pests and diseases that hit eggplant fields most often: [eggplant fruit and shoot borer](/pests/eggplant-fruit-and-shoot-borer), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest about 45 days after transplanting.
**Yield:** 32 to 133 percent more marketable fruit than the commercial check in national trials, 2011 to 2014, Ramgo claims 30 to 35 t/ha.
**Fruit:** Glossy dark purple cylinder with a rounded tip, 15 to 22 cm long, 3.3 to 4.4 cm across, green to purplish green calyx.
Resistant to bacterial wilt, intermediate resistance to leafhopper.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: public IPB UPLB hybrid that Ramgo sells commercially, on DA Region 2's recommended list. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Sikat eggplant

It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Buyers in each market want their own talong: long and slim and dark purple in most of Luzon, rounder or striped in some towns. Pick a variety with bacterial wilt resistance, and plan for the fruit and shoot borer whatever you plant, because no variety on the market resists it. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Sikat F1 the same as Sikat?
items.a: Yes. Sikat F1 is another name for Sikat, registered as NSIC 2015 Eg 05H. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Sikat?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
